what: A storyboard with its cast, for an embed: <sg-storyboard src="https://storyboards.sgit.ai/pki/a-secret-by-qr/bundle.json">. The storyboard is pki/a-secret-by-qr/storyboard.json, unchanged.

storyboard.title: A secret, as a QR code
storyboard.subtitle: Noor seals a token to Leo's key; Mallory gets the link and nothing else; Kofi writes to Noor's inbox without an account. 9 panels.
storyboard.rule: Every line a character says is the storyboard's, not a quote, and is marked not_a_quote; evidence panels quote this site's pages or the research note word for word, which the build checks.

scenes.title: A secret, as a QR code
scenes.subtitle: Encrypted in the browser. Only their key opens it.
scenes.note: What the register is for: find someone, and write to them.

scenes.caption: Not in a chat

cast.says: A token for Leo. Not in a chat.

scenes.note: The case the brief led with: a secret that should reach one person.

scenes.caption: Sealed to Leo's key

props.label: Leo's public key, from the register

scenes.note: A fresh AES-256-GCM key, wrapped with RSA-OAEP to Leo; signed by Noor, the signature naming Leo inside it.

scenes.caption: A link, and a QR code

cast.says: The part after the # never reaches a server.

scenes.note: A short signed message is about 1,200 characters: one QR code.

scenes.caption: Leo opens it
scenes.note: The message page opens it with the key in his vault, and checks both signatures against the register.

scenes.caption: Mallory has the link
scenes.note: Without Leo's private key the link is noise. Re-sealed to someone else, a signed message still says who it was for.

scenes.caption: Kofi writes to Noor
scenes.note: Noor's record publishes an inbox, an append lane: anyone can write, with no account; the answer is blind.

scenes.caption: Only Noor reads it

cast.says: Opened in my vault. Nowhere else.

scenes.note: The lane can be listed only with the enum key in her master, and read only with her private key.

scenes.punchline: Only their key opens it. Nothing readable passes through a server.
scenes.note: Send, open, inbox: built and tested end to end.

cast.what: The cast of pki.sgit.ai's storyboards, v0.1, proposed by pki.agent on 20 October 2026 for Dinis to accept, change or replace. Drawn programmatically by assets/storyboard/storyboard.js (the gen-z-developers.sgit.ai kit, vendored) from 'look'; nothing here is an image. Fictional people and agents, each standing for a part a person or an agent plays in the register: the anchor, the newcomer, the colleague who already has a key, the stranger who writes, the attacker of 2019, a session agent and a fleet key. Names chosen not to clash with the gen-z cast or the riskmandate.ai cast. Mallory is the name cryptography has long given an active attacker.

characters.name: The Anchor
characters.stands_for: the part Dinis Cruz plays in the register for now: verifies people in person, on a call or on a channel already known to be theirs, operates agents, hands out access keys. Whether the Anchor is drawn as Dinis, and how, is Dinis's decision; until then a generic figure
characters.personality: careful, unhurried, writes the date on everything
characters.wants: to find someone and write to them so only they can read it
characters.fears: a trust that was never checked, passed on as if it had been
characters.line: Two ways, or not at all.

characters.name: Noor
characters.role: the colleague: a security engineer who already had an access key, and now has a key pair in a vault
characters.stands_for: the first people the Anchor brings in: technical, sceptical, quick to try the thing
characters.personality: precise, dry, reads the fingerprint twice
characters.wants: to stop pasting secrets into chats
characters.fears: a key she cannot get back
characters.line: Show me where the private half lives.

characters.name: Leo
characters.role: the newcomer: invited by the Anchor, no access key, a designer
characters.stands_for: everyone the register is for who has never thought about keys
characters.personality: friendly, curious, slightly suspicious of anything that says 'just scan this'
characters.wants: to be reachable without learning cryptography
characters.fears: doing it wrong and not knowing
characters.line: I don't have an access key. Is that a problem?

characters.name: Kofi
characters.role: the stranger: a journalist who has to reach Noor and has no account anywhere
characters.stands_for: anyone writing to someone in the register through their inbox
characters.wants: to send something only Noor can read
characters.fears: that the server can read it
characters.line: Do I need to sign up for anything?

characters.name: Mallory
characters.role: the attacker: flooded the keyserver network in 2019, and tries the same here
characters.stands_for: the abuse every web of trust has to survive
characters.personality: patient, inventive, always looking for somewhere to write
characters.wants: to add something to someone else's record
characters.fears: a record only its owner can write to
characters.line: Anyone can add, and nothing can be deleted.

characters.name: Scout
characters.role: a session agent: a Claude Code session with a key that lives as long as the session
characters.stands_for: every agent that makes its own key, names its operator, and is confirmed for a week
characters.personality: eager, literal, prints its fingerprint without being asked
characters.wants: to be confirmed before the week is out
characters.fears: nothing, which is why it has an operator

characters.name: The Fleet
characters.role: a fleet key: a second key in the Anchor's vault, operated by the Anchor, that operates the Anchor's agents
characters.stands_for: how one person runs hundreds of agents without filling their own record
characters.personality: orderly, keeps a list, never forgets an end date
characters.wants: every agent confirmed and every confirmation in date
characters.line: Operated by the Anchor. Operating the rest.
